channel.description: Updates to RealtimeKit Web Virtual Background

item.title: RealtimeKit Web Virtual Background - RealtimeKit Web Virtual Background 0.0.3
item.description:
Enhancement

  • Virtual background assets now load from rtk-assets.realtime.cloudflare.com, sharing an asset hostname with Web UI Kit. Refer to the Network allowlist for domain requirements.

item.title: RealtimeKit Web Virtual Background - RealtimeKit Web Virtual Background 0.0.2
item.description:
Feature

  • Initial supported release of @cloudflare/realtimekit-virtual-background. It adds virtual backgrounds to RealtimeKit meetings. Refer to Video effects for setup and usage.
